'''Hanar-Ye''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Voss|same name]] well before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. One of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystics]] of their [[Species/Legends|species]], Hanar-Ye [[Death/Legends|died]] many years before [[3640 BBY]], and their [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] remained within the [[Shrine of Healing]] on Voss alongside fellow Mystics [[Shanatka-Lo]] and [[Laeras-Wu]] to teach [[The Force/Legends|Force rituals]] to other Mystics and healers. The three Mystics' spirits taught the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] a [[Voss healing ritual|healing ritual]] at the request of the Mystic [[Valen-Da]], and though Fulminiss corrupted the ritual with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], the three spirits remained confident in the wisdom of their fellow Mystic.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Valen-Da left a message. In the corner.|Hanar-Ye|<ref name="Bloody" />}}
[[File:Fulminiss_Head.png|thumb|right|220px|Fulminiss, the Sith who learned the ritual from Hanar-Ye]]
The [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Hanar-Ye was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] and spent their whole life on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Hanar-Ye became a [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] who was capable of [[Force vision/Legends|seeing the future]]. Hanar-Ye [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="Bloody" /> sometime well before [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> but their [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] remained behind in the [[Shrine of Healing]] on Voss along with the spirits of fellow Mystics [[Shanatka-Lo]] and [[Laeras-Wu]]. The three spirits shared their knowledge with visiting Mystics and healers, including the secrets of a [[Voss healing ritual|healing ritual]] that could heal the mind of a patient by drawing on the strength of many.<ref name="Bloody" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 3640 BBY,<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Mystic [[Valen-Da]] visited the Shrine with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]].<ref name="Bloody" />

Because Valen-Da was a Mystic and therefore infallible in Voss [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Hanar-Ye and their companions taught Fulminiss the healing ritual, though the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] corrupted the ritual so that it tore open the minds of its victims; the three spirits watched as Fulminiss used the ritual against the healers who had accompanied Valen-Da. Valen-Da and Fulminiss then departed the Shrine, though the spirits witnessed Valen-Da leave a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] in the corner of the chamber with a message for the [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] [[Tala-Reh]]. When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] arrived at the Shrine in search of Valen-Da not long afterwards, Hanar-Ye and the others saw the deranged healers attack the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and force the Knight to kill them in self-defense. The three Mystics then appeared to the Knight and explained what Fulminiss had done with the ritual, and they then faded away after informing the Knight of Valen-Da's message for Tala-Reh.<ref name="Bloody" />

==Personality and traits==
A Force-sensitive Voss male, Hanar sported the [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and blue patterned skin common to males of their species, and their skin was various shades of blue and white. Like all Voss, Hanar-Ye did not possess [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. As a spirit, the Mystic appeared as a ghostly yellow apparition, and retained the belief that the wisdom of the Mystics was unquestionable even after their death.<ref name="Bloody" />

==Equipment==
Hanar-Ye wore Mystic [[Robe/Legends|robes]] that were white and blue in color.<ref name="Bloody" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hanar-Ye first appeared in the Jedi Knight class mission "Bloody Pilgrimage" on the planet Voss in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Bloody" />
